title: Collision of Orbits on an Elliptic Surface
summary: Let $C$ be a smooth projective curve defined over $\Qbar$, let $π:\mathcal{E}\lra C$ be an elliptic surface and let $σ_{P_1},σ_{P_2},σ_{Q}$ be sections of $π$ (corresponding to points $P_1,P_2, Q$ of the generic fiber $E$ of $\mathcal{E}$). We obtain a precise characterization, expressed solely in terms of the dynamical relations between the points $P_1,P_2,Q$ with respect to the endomorphism ring of $E$, so that there exist infinitely many $ł\in C(\Qbar)$ with the property that for some nonzero integers $m_{1,ł},m_{2,ł}$, we have that $[m_{i,ł}](σ_{P_{i}}(ł))=σ_{Q}(ł)$ (for $i=1,2$) on the…
